🎬 The Neighborhood (2018–Present)

The Neighborhood follows Dave Johnson, a friendly and optimistic man from Michigan who moves with his wife Gemma and their young son Grover into a predominantly Black neighborhood in Pasadena, California, hoping to start a new chapter in their lives. However, their arrival quickly catches the attention of their outspoken and skeptical next-door neighbor Calvin Butler, a proud longtime resident who isn’t particularly excited about welcoming newcomers into his community. While Dave enthusiastically attempts to build a friendship with Calvin, his overly friendly personality and constant efforts to fit in often lead to hilarious misunderstandings, awkward situations, and unexpected disagreements. Meanwhile, Calvin’s warmhearted wife Tina develops a friendship with Gemma, while their sons Malcolm and Marty become involved in the families’ everyday adventures. From neighborhood disputes and embarrassing family gatherings to workplace challenges, romantic complications, and important conversations about cultural differences, the two households gradually discover they have more in common than they initially believed. As their friendships grow stronger, they learn valuable lessons about acceptance, respect, communication, and community. Combining hilarious comedy, heartfelt storytelling, relatable family struggles, and meaningful social commentary, the series celebrates friendship, family, diversity, and the unexpected connections that bring people together.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Jim Reynolds

📺 Where to Watch: Check Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
